segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func fourFoldTranslated(inputImage: CIImage) -> CIImage { let fourFoldTranslatedTile = CIFilter.fourfoldTranslatedTile() fourFoldTranslatedTile.inputImage = inputImage fourFoldTranslatedTile.center = CGPoint(x: inputImage.extent.midX, y: inputImage.extent.midY) fourFoldTranslatedTile.angle = 1 fourFoldTranslatedTile.width = 400 fourFoldTranslatedTile.acuteAngle = 1 return fourFoldTranslatedTile.outputImage!.cropped(to: inputImage.extent) } ```
